```sql
SELECT COUNT(*) AS entry_count
FROM results r
JOIN races ra ON r."raceId" = ra."raceId"
JOIN constructors c ON r."constructorId" = c."constructorId"
WHERE c."constructorRef" = 'brawn'
  AND ra."year" = 2009
  AND ra."date" <= '2009-07-01'
```
